propositions: A single pending entry disables the O(1) fast-path marker, causing full store walks on every subsequent write (O(store size) cost)
The marker write logic clears the marker whenever pending entries exist, rather than recording which entries are live
Cost scales linearly with store size and weakly with backlog depth; a marker miss on a 4,938-ticket store costs 1.2-1.3 seconds per write
The gate marker should track a set-valued 'live' field of currently-enqueued tickets and scope subsequent scans to only those entries (O(backlog) instead of O(store))
TTL-fresh markers with live sets should NOT be rewritten on scoped probes, preserving the TTL bound to the last full walk
Scoped probes must preserve service-order parity (not_before_ns, ticket_id sort) with full walks and remain honest about absence of pending work
